patch:
diff --git a/django/utils/dateparse.py b/django/utils/dateparse.py
index bf115f07b8..90ba8aa1fc 100644
--- a/django/utils/dateparse.py
+++ b/django/utils/dateparse.py
@@ -35,9 +35,10 @@ datetime_re = re.compile(
 standard_duration_re = re.compile(
     r'^'
     r'(?:(?P<days>-?\d+) (days?, )?)?'
-    r'((?:(?P<hours>-?\d+):)(?=\d+:\d+))?'
-    r'(?:(?P<minutes>-?\d+):)?'
-    r'(?P<seconds>-?\d+)'
+    r'(?P<sign>[-+]?)'
+    r'((?:(?P<hours>\d+):)(?=\d+:\d+))?'
+    r'(?:(?P<minutes>\d+):)?'
+    r'(?P<seconds>\d+)'
     r'(?:\.(?P<microseconds>\d{1,6})\d{0,6})?'
     r'$'
 )
